title: Import from your computer's aliases
computer_hint: Reads the aliases that run claude in this computer's ~/.zshrc, ~/.bashrc and ~/.bash_aliases, grouped by URL and key. The hub reads the keys from the computer; they never pass through the browser.
empty: No claude aliases to import in this computer's ~/.zshrc, ~/.bashrc or ~/.bash_aliases.
merge_note: Merging only adds new models to the existing provider. Other settings stay the same.
no_computers: No computer is connected yet. Importing reads the aliases on one of your computers, so add one under Machines first.
merge_hint: Uses {alias}'s settings. The others add only their model.
hide: Hide the imported aliases in Persona
hide_hint: Your shell files aren't changed. Hidden aliases can be restored under Hidden.
